name: lemmeknow
description: Fast pattern recognition tool that identifies text patterns, formats, and encodings using regex and machine learning algorithms

lemmeknow.description: Advanced pattern identification tool for analyzing unknown text formats, encodings, hashes, and data structures with confidence scoring
lemmeknow.usage:
lemmeknow "base64encodedtext"
lemmeknow --json "hash123456"
lemmeknow --verbose "unknown_pattern"
lemmeknow --min 0.5 --max 1.0 "data"
lemmeknow --include hash "md5string"
lemmeknow --exclude email "mixeddata"
